edges: The Xbox One's hardware architecture is fundamentally incompatible with the original Xbox games.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The Xbox One X cannot play these games because it respects that they are a tribute to a bygone era.
The Xbox One X can play selected titles, but not all original Xbox games.
The architecture of the original Xbox's processor is based on a 32-bit system, while the Xbox One X's processor uses a 64-bit system.
The Xbox One X can play these games.
